data_fields.name: digest_cadence
data_fields.donor_constant: every turn (one update per process_packets call)

best_idea: Each turn both sides fold the synchronised state into one integer digest, the server compares each client digest to its own (missing or different is a mismatch), and any corrective action is capped by a free-attempts count plus a cooldown.
decision_why: Peer compare and host-run resync assume lockstep between peers; Frankendom is server-authoritative, so keep only the per-turn integer digest for row 19 replay checks, with live use logging only.
acceptance: A server test replays a recorded 3-vs-1 fight through src/fight and asserts every turn digest matches the stored digest; changing one recorded hp value fails at that turn.
